review.reviewer: current Codex assistant, candidate author and explicit source/algorithm reviewer
review.algorithm_assessment: All dimensions below a reached maximum are freely accessible and their curses are suppressed. Add zero-cost downward edges and charge a magic upward destination curse. A minimum path never needs a paid jump below a previously reached maximum: it can skip that detour using free descent. Thus ordinary nonnegative Dijkstra captures the optimal increasing-maximum sequence without storing a visited-curse set.
review.limitations: One source reviewer plus actual isolated tests, not independent dual semantic review.
